item.title: Fractional Model of Gelatin Viscoelasticity
item.description: We experimentally test a fractional calculus model with minimal instrumentation, using simple rheological methods.

item.description: Measurement of the Hall effect using thin bismuth films produced without specialized equipment.

item.title: Wavelength Measurement by Circular Diffraction
item.description: An intensity analysis of photographs and their diffraction patterns was performed to estimate the wavelength of a laser.

item.title: Conducción de Calor y Gradiente de Temperatura en dos Dimensiones
item.description: An experimental setup was designed and executed to verify the two-dimensional temperature gradient described by Fourier’s law of heat conduction.
